caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic container with a cylindrical domed lid, centrally placed on a plain background. The container has a rectangular body with softly rounded vertical edges and sits on a base with a stepped profile. The surface of the container is decorated on the front with an ornate, symmetrical shield-like emblem featuring flourishes and scrollwork. Inside the emblem is a smaller coat of arms or crest with a depiction of a bird or animal. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray, using fine lines and subtle shading to represent the reflective quality of the metal and the details of the ornamentation. There is no background detail or additional objects, and the overall composition centers the container on the page.
title: Silver Tea Caddy
